title: Split, Join, Upper
hints: `split`: `s.find(delim, start)` returns the index of the next delimiter at or after `start`, or `std::string::npos` when there is none. `s.substr(start, len)` copies out a piece. Loop while a delimiter is found, then push the final piece after the loop, even if it is empty.

`join`: start with an empty `std::string` and `+=` each part; add `sep` before every part except the first (`if (i) out += sep;`). `to_upper` takes `s` by value, so you already own a copy and can mutate it with `for (char& c : s)`.
